The '''Sundari Flatlands''' was a region on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. During the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], it was a hotly contested area because of the [[Balmorran Arms Factory]]'s location there.
